exposure: selective lateral lymph node (LLN) dissection without neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT)
selective lateral lymph node (LLN) dissection after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT)
cohort: 466 patients with rectal cancer and clinical evidence of LLN metastases treated across three hospitals in China.
finding: Selective LLN dissection after nCRT is safe and feasible with acceptable perioperative outcomes, and patients with a post-nCRT LLN short diameter >=7 mm or poor/mucinous/signet adenocarcinoma should receive supplementary LLN dissection after nCRT.
who: Patients with rectal cancer with clinical evidence of LLN metastases
